question: The total surface area of a solid hemisphere is 16632 cm². Its volume is: (Take π = 22/7)
solution:
**Given:**

TSA of Hemisphere = 16632 cm²

**Formula used:**

Volume of solid hemisphere = (2)/(3)pi r³

**Calculation:-**

It is given that the total surface area of the hemisphere is 16632 cm2

Total surface area** **= 3 π r2

⇒ 3 × π × r2 = 16632

⇒ r2 = 5544/π 

⇒ r2 = 1764 

⇒ r = 42 cm

Volume = (2)/(3)pi r³

V = (2)/(3)times (22)/(7) times r³

⇒ (2)/(3)times (22)/(7) times 42³

On solving,

V = 155232 cm³

**∴ The volume of the solid hemisphere is 155232 cm³.**
